row.body: A book is wrapped in a note asking someone to bring it on a family visit; the back mentions keeping the garden hose off the marked ground.
row.title: A gift for the visit

sidecar.gloss: A family gift travels with a warning to avoid using water on the marked ground.
sidecar.rival_reading: A responder could have restricted water use around a grave or household; the note does not identify the reason.
